function.description: Retrieves a list of all Security Service Insertions (SSIs) configured across fabric sites, sorted by name.
function.name: api_securityServiceInsertions

limit.description: Maximum number of records to be fetched. If not provided, 500 records will be fetched by default

name.description: Filter by virtual network name (supports partial search).          For example, searching for "virtual" will match "virtual-network1", "virtual-network2", etc.

offset.description: The first record to show for this page. Minimum value is 1

order.description: The sorting order for the response can be specified as either ascending (asc) or descending (desc). The default order is ascending (asc).

response.description: A list of Security Service Insertions (SSIs) configured across fabric sites.

id.description: The unique identifier of the Security Service Insertion (SSI).

siteId.description: The ID of the fabric site where the service insertion is configured.

virtualNetworks.description: The list of virtual networks which are selected for steering traffic towards the firewall.

devices.description: The list of border devices selected per VN for firewall

id.description: The unique identifier of the network device.

layer3Handoffs.description: Contains information regarding the firewall connection and IP addressing.

firewallIpV4AddressWithMask.description: The IPv4 address and subnet mask of the firewall.

id.description: The unique identifier of the layer3 handoff.
The unique identifier of the virtual network associated with the service insertion.

name.description: Name of the virtual network associated with the fabric site.
